visualCharacteristics.structure: responsive grid of cards, one card per authored row; default bordered tiles with hover lift on linked cards; promo borderless image-forward tiles; profile centered person cards with circular portrait, name, italic role line and inline social links (1 col mobile, 2 at 600px, 3 at 900px, 4 at 1200px)

contentPattern: rows of image cell + body cell; profile body = h3 name + role paragraph + list of social links
